summary: Available Summer 2024 · 5/6 Bedroom Property · £162 PPPW · Upmarket Styling · Excellent Jesmond Location
description:
My Property Box welcome to the market for the 2024 student season this stunning five or six bedroom maisonette on Buston Terrace, Jesmond.

A firm favorite with students, the property's modern contemporary decor oozes class with upmarket furnishings and styling. Featuring a large central living room leading to generous galley kitchen, the property hosts six double bedrooms across two floors. Two bathrooms, one to each floor. Street permit parking is available. This property is situated a stones throw to Osborne Road and Jesmond's bars and amenities. Ideally suited to a group who are looking for a modern property with excellent access to Jesmond and both university campuses.

Contact MPB today to arrange a viewing.
